description: Design and System-on-Chip (SOC) implementation for signal processing applications. SOC design and testing methodologies, Platform-based design, Intellectual Property (IP) reuse, and built-in self-test. Controlling power consumption in SOC implementations. SOC multi-technology integration of analog and digital electronics, sensors and MEMS.

groupFilter1.name: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

      • CENG355 - Microprocessor-Based Systems (1.5)
      • CSC355 - Digital Logic and Computer Organization (1.5)
      • MECH405 - Introduction to Microprocessors (1.5)
      • MECH458 - Mechatronics (1.5)
    • Complete 1 of the following
      • Complete 1 of:
        • ECE310 - Digital Signal Processing I (1.5)
        • ELEC310 - Digital Signal Processing I (1.5)
      • Complete all of:

        • MECH455 - Instrumentation (1.5)
supplementalNotes:

title: System-on-Chip Engineering for Signal Processing
